svg.title: EEG analysis pipeline — stages 1 to 6
svg.desc: Chronological single-column flowchart of the rebuilt EEG pipeline from raw data ingestion through feature engineering

g.text: Computes true fs, Butterworth 7-band split, active-baseline
normalisation, flags BT dropout segments, logs dropout stats
Outputs: per-participant .pkl of relative power arrays + dropout log
Detects blink epochs on AF7/AF8 (peak-to-peak > threshold)
Detects EMG bursts on TP9/TP10 (broadband power spike)
Does NOT remove — flags epochs with binary mask for downstream
Outputs: same .pkl + artifact_mask column + summary CSV
Extracts 3s SKIP windows (1 per keypress, terminates at keypress)
Extracts STAY windows only from videos watched ≥ min_stay_dur s
Outputs: windowed dataset .pkl + per-participant label summary CSV
Undersamples STAY to 50/50 for each seed independently
Creates temporal 5-fold CV blocks with 3s inter-block gap
Outputs: 5 balanced split manifests per participant per seed
Computes 4 stats × 7 bands × 4 ch = 112 features (full set)
Also computes AF7/AF8-only (56 feat) and TP9/TP10-only (56 feat)
Also computes EI scalar (β / α+θ, averaged across all 4 ch)
Outputs: three feature matrices + EI column, per participant
Runs nested CV: outer = temporal 5-fold, inner = 3-fold
Selects best hyperparams per participant on inner folds only
Locks params before any outer-fold evaluation — no leakage
Outputs: best_params.json per participant + grid search report
continues in part 2 — modelling and evaluation

svg.text: Purple = signal processing Teal = labelling and splits Amber = features and tuning
